narrative.details:
Qiraji magic is strong and ancient.  The most powerful qiraji wield items of such might, they'd give pause even to a dragon.

Bring me the qiraji bindings of dominance and other minor components by and I'll create a set of powerful boots for you.

You will find them useful in the fight against the enemy.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Qiraji Bindings of Dominance, 2 Idols of the Sun, 5 Silver Scarabs and 5 Crystal Scarabs to Kandrostrasz in Ahn'Qiraj.  This quest also requires Neutral faction with the Brood of Nozdormu.
narrative.offerRewardText: You've done well, adventurer. You've proven you're no ordinary mortal.I give you these with the confidence they'll aid you in crushing the vile qiraji.
narrative.requestItemsText: You've acquired the items I requested, adventurer?
